Brand Visibility Audit Workbook for AI Answers

Quick start: paste AI answers for each target question, and this workbook will calculate brand visibility rate and average rank against competitors, plus sentiment and missing topics. It highlights quote snippets and explains why a competitor won using local rules such as the presence of a number, a date, a direct answer, or a matching source page, then creates a prioritized weekly fix list with Canvas charts and CSV or JSON export. No account, connection, or persistent storage needed; export a JSON file to save your work and import it later, and re-import it in any browser later without any external service.
